Multiple radars in the Netherlands will be replaced over the coming years. The purpose of deploying a mobile radar is to maintain the continuity of the operation. It is important to keep sufficient Mode-S coverage during the replacement of a radar. Furthermore, the mobile Mode S radar could potentially be used when a radar fails. This way, there are no capacity limitations in the event of failure of another radar. On this TenderNed platform, a Questionnaire can be directly downloaded. This Questionnaire contains all relevant details such as a business specification and an elaborate list of questions for which LVNL seeks your valued advice. Please use this Questionnaire to write down your answers and submit this document to the contact person for this marktet consultation.
